content.content: When `deccy validate` finds failures, the deccy CLI shall write one line to stdout per failure as `<check> <id> <reason>`.
content.rationale: Pipes and agents need per-failure handles naming the failed check, the node, and the reason; exit 2 on failures would collide with the O1/O2 refusal shape since a multi-line stdout report cannot be a refusal, and a reserved status 1 re-opens S4-one-free. Failures are reports rather than refusals, so O4 forces exit 0 always. One `<check> <id> <reason>` line keeps the report greppable under O5's line discipline. States only the rendering fact without re-deciding D16c's exercising, D9's three checks, O4's status rule, O5's channel rules, or sspsomkw's verdict-freedom.
